integrity: Standalone finite checker and complete mathematical proof included; finite checks support, but do not establish, the infinite classification. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Only labeled minimum total-three-dominating sets on K_3 Cartesian K_n, n>=2; not higher widths, different k or all nonminimum solutions. The minimum value n>=5 is established in a 2017 paper, not new. No independent priority certification.
title: Complete minimum total \(3\)-domination census for three-row rook graphs
